senses.gloss:
n. (-कं)
1 Eagerness, vehemence, impatience.
2 Joy, pleasure, happiness.
3 Sport, pastime.
4 A festival, festivity.
5 Wish, inclination.
6 Curiosity.
7 Kind or friendly greeting, civility, salutation.
8 The marriage thread or ring.
9 The enjoyment of public diversions.
10 Song, dance, shew or spectacle.
11 Season of enjoyment.
E.
कुतुक, and अण् aff.

n. (-लं)
1 Eagerness, vehemence.
2 Curiosity.
E.
कुतूहल and अण् pleonastic affix; also with ष्यञ् affix, कौतूहल्य n. (-ल्यं)

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Eager, vehement.
2 Curious.
E.
कौतूहल^1, and अन्वित having.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161202. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 303.
